source.enumeration_basis: Every line of source/codigo-penal-1940.txt that opens an article ('Art. N', 'Art N', 'Art. N-X', 'Art. N-X-Y', revoked ones included), enumerated mechanically by the conductor and checked against 'every article number 1-361 is present'. Units are articles; an article's paragraphs, incisos and alíneas are within its unit. Merged by registers/merge-parts.py from one part per encoder.

units.title: Anterioridade da Lei
units.note: Both sentences: `há lei anterior que define o fato como crime (art. 1º)` and `há prévia cominação legal da pena (art. 1º)`, over the succession of laws `Fato no tempo`; the first arms of `a lei que rege o fato (arts. 1º a 4º)`.

units.title: Lei penal no tempo
units.note: Caput (abolitio criminis, excepting art. 3º's laws) and parágrafo único (the later law that favours the agent, including a lei intermediária, fork F-g1a-01; several listed, never combined, fork F-g1a-02). Also `a redação alcança o fato (arts. 2º e 4º)`, the one-line test for Parte Especial penalty rules after a re-wording. Fork F-sweep-a-06 (Súmula 711) settles crimes permanentes and continuados.

units.title: Lei excepcional ou temporária (Incluído pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)
units.note: `a lei excepcional ou temporária rege o fato praticado durante sua vigência (art. 3º)`; it is excepted from art. 2º's abolitio and lex mitior (fork F-g1a-03).

units.title: Tempo do crime
units.note: `o tempo do crime (art. 4º)` (the shared Fato's `data do fato`, whatever the result's date) and, for a crime permanente or continuado, `o dia que fixa a lei aplicável (art. 4º; Súmula 711 STF)` (fork F-sweep-a-06, M-sweep-a-16).

units.title: Territorialidade
units.note: Caput (with the proviso for conventions, treaties and rules of international law as an input finding), § 1º and § 2º: `o lugar está sob a lei brasileira (art. 5º)`, `a bordo, aplica-se a lei brasileira (art. 5º)`, `aplica-se a lei brasileira pela territorialidade (art. 5º)`. Fork F-g1a-04 ('espaço aéreo correspondente').

units.title: Lugar do crime (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 1984)
units.note: `o crime é praticado no território nacional (arts. 5º e 6º)` over `Lugar do crime`: the action or omission in whole or in part, where the result happened, or where it was to happen.

units.title: Extraterritorialidade (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 1984)
units.note: Incisos I (a–d) and II (a–c), §§ 1º, 2º (a–e) and 3º (a–b): `a extraterritorialidade (art. 7º)` returns which hypothesis applies, and whether the § 2º conditions are met; the classes of crime are the Parte Especial's characterisation, supplied with the case.

units.title: Pena cumprida no estrangeiro (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)
units.note: `o efeito da pena cumprida no estrangeiro (art. 8º)` (computada if of the same kind among art. 32's three, fork F-g1a-05; atenua otherwise) and `o tempo que resta cumprir no Brasil (art. 8º)`, which refuses by name where the judge fixes the attenuation or the penalty is a fine.

units.title: Eficácia de sentença estrangeira (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)
units.note: `a sentença estrangeira pode ser homologada (art. 9º)`: incisos I and II and the parágrafo único's two conditions. Which court homologates (the STJ since EC 45/2004) is procedure, outside the Code.

units.title: Contagem de prazo (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)
units.note: Encoded whole by g0 in cp-pena.l4, § 'Art. 10 — Contagem de prazo': `o último dia do prazo` (first day counts; calendar months; fork F-g0-02 for a month end with no day of the same number).

units.title: Frações não computáveis da pena (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)
units.note: Encoded whole by g0 in cp-pena.l4, § 'Art. 11 — Frações não computáveis da pena': `desprezadas as frações de dia` and `desprezadas as frações da moeda` (cruzeiro read as the real, fork F-g0-12; when in the calculation, fork F-g0-04).

units.title: Legislação especial (Incluída pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)
units.note: `as regras gerais do Código aplicam-se ao fato previsto em lei especial (art. 12)`, over the finding whether the special law provides otherwise; the special laws themselves are outside this encoding.

units.title: Relação de causalidade (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)
units.note: Caput (the conditio sine qua non, a finding), § 1º (a relatively independent supervening cause that by itself produced the result; the earlier acts stay imputed) and § 2º (the omission's relevance: a duty from a), b) or c), and the possibility of acting). `a imputação do resultado (art. 13)` names each outcome; `o resultado é imputável ao agente (art. 13)` is the boolean the Parte Especial's result crimes call.

units.title: Relevância da omissão (Incluído pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)
units.note: Encoded whole by g0 in cp-pena.l4, § 'Art. 14 — Crime consumado e tentativa': `crime consumado (art. 14, I)`, `crime tentado (art. 14, II)`, `diminuição pela tentativa (art. 14, parágrafo único)`, `a pena cominada à tentativa (art. 14, parágrafo único)`. Whether all the elements of a given offence are present is each offence module's to decide.

units.title: Desistência voluntária e arrependimento eficaz (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)
units.note: `desistência voluntária (art. 15)`, `arrependimento eficaz (art. 15)`, `o agente só responde pelos atos já praticados (art. 15)`, as arms of `o desfecho da execução (arts. 14, 15 e 17)`. Voluntary need not be spontaneous (fork F-g1a-07).

units.title: Arrependimento posterior (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)
units.note: `diminuição do art. 16` (one to two thirds, mandatory: 'será reduzida'), `incide a diminuição do art. 16` over the shared Fato's means and `Reparação do dano`, and `as causas de diminuição cabíveis (art. 16)`. The day of receipt is in time; violence against a thing and a non-grave threat do not bar it (fork F-g1a-08); the reparation must be whole (fork F-g1a-09).

units.title: Crime impossível (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)
units.note: `crime impossível (art. 17)`: absolute inefficacy of the means, absolute impropriety of the object, and, by STF Súmula 145, a flagrante the police prepared so that consummation was impossible; surveillance alone does not make it impossible (STJ Súmula 567). Fork F-sweep-a-07, M-sweep-a-18 and M-sweep-a-19.

units.title: Crime impossível (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)
units.note: I (dolo: wanted the result or took on the risk), II (culpa: imprudência, negligência, imperícia), and the parágrafo único (culposo only where the law expressly provides it, an input from the offence): `crime doloso (art. 18, I)`, `crime culposo (art. 18, II)`, `a modalidade do crime (art. 18)`, `o fato é punível quanto ao elemento subjetivo (art. 18, parágrafo único)`.

units.title: Agravação pelo resultado (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)
units.note: `o agente responde pelo resultado que agrava especialmente a pena (art. 19)`: the aggravating result is imputable to the agent (art. 13) and reached at least culposamente (art. 18). For every form qualified by its result.

units.title: Erro sobre elementos do tipo (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)
units.note: Caput (error on an element of the tipo excludes dolo; culposo if the error derives from culpa and the law provides the form), § 1º (descriminantes putativas: the supposed situation is judged by art. 23, read per ADPF 779; fork F-g1a-14 for a culpable error with no culposo form), § 2º (the third party who determines the error) and § 3º (`a vítima cujas condições se consideram (art. 20, § 3º)`: the intended victim's qualities). `o efeito do erro (art. 20)` names each outcome.

units.title: Erro sobre a ilicitude do fato (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)
units.note: Ignorance of the law inescusable (a closed ground, `o desconhecimento da lei escusa (art. 21)` MEANS FALSE), the inevitable error exempts, the avoidable one allows `diminuição do art. 21` (one sixth to one third, 'poderá', fork F-g1a-13); the parágrafo único's definition of avoidable. `o efeito do erro sobre a ilicitude (art. 21)`.

units.title: Coação irresistível e obediência hierárquica (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)
units.note: `só é punível o autor da coação ou da ordem (art. 22)`: irresistible coercion, or strict obedience to an order of a hierarchical superior that is not manifestly illegal (fork F-g1a-15 for 'superior hierárquico' and 'coação'). The attenuation for resistible coercion or a manifestly illegal order is art. 65, III, c (g1b).

units.title: Exclusão de ilicitude (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)
units.note: Incisos I–III and the parágrafo único (excess doloso or culposo): `o efeito das excludentes de ilicitude (art. 23)` names which excludente applies or which excess the agent answers for; `não há crime (art. 23)` is the boolean. Inciso II is read down by ADPF 779 (M-sweep-a-01), through art. 25. The excess with neither dolo nor culpa is named and not punished (fork F-g1a-12).

units.title: Estado de necessidade
units.note: Caput, § 1º (legal duty to face the danger) and § 2º (`diminuição do art. 24, § 2º`, one to two thirds where the sacrifice could reasonably be required; 'poderá', fork F-g1a-13). Current danger and a danger caused culpably: the findings carry the Code's words (fork F-g1a-11).

units.title: Legítima defesa
units.note: Caput and parágrafo único (Lei nº 13.964/2019; declaratory, since it demands the caput's requisites: fork F-g1a-10), read down by ADPF 779 (binding entry M-sweep-a-01): the rule-version arm 'arts. 23, II, e 25 lidos conforme ADPF 779 (2023-08-01)' is `a situação de legítima defesa (art. 25)`, keyed on the date of the decision (fork F-g1a-06); before 1.8.2023 the honour thesis refuses by name, and the arm touches nothing else.

units.title: Inimputáveis
units.note: Caput (exempt from penalty: mental illness or incomplete/retarded development, wholly incapable of understanding or of self-determination) and parágrafo único (`diminuição do art. 26, parágrafo único`, one to two thirds, 'pode'; a disturbance of mental health, read to include a mental illness that left some capacity: fork F-g1a-16). The medidas de segurança that follow (arts. 96–98) are g1c's.

units.title: Menores de dezoito anos
units.note: `penalmente inimputável por ser menor de dezoito anos (art. 27)`, through cp-pena's `menor de` 18 at the date of the conduct (forks F-g0-06, F-g0-01). The special legislation (ECA) is outside this encoding (M-sweep-a-37, scoped out).

units.title: Emoção e paixão
units.note: I and II as grounds the Code closes (constant FALSE disjuncts in `o agente é isento de pena por inimputabilidade (arts. 26 a 28)`), § 1º (complete intoxication from a chance event or force majeure, wholly incapable: exempt) and § 2º (`diminuição do art. 28, § 2º`, one to two thirds). `a imputabilidade do agente (arts. 26 a 28)` names which article applies.

units.title: DO CONCURSO DE PESSOAS
units.note: Caput (the unitary rule: whoever concurs in any way incurs the crime's penalties), § 1º (`diminuição do art. 29, § 1º`, one sixth to one third, 'pode'; fork F-g1a-18 on participant or co-author) and § 2º (the less serious crime's pena applies, `aumento do art. 29, § 2º` up to one half where the graver result was foreseeable; 'menos grave' measured as in F-g0-18, fork F-g1a-19): `a pena cominada ao concorrente (art. 29)`, `as causas do concorrente (art. 29, §§ 1º e 2º)`. 'Na medida de sua culpabilidade' is art. 59's weighing (g1b).

units.title: Circunstâncias incomunicáveis
units.note: `a circunstância se comunica aos demais concorrentes (art. 30)`: personal circumstances and conditions do not extend to the others, save when elements of the crime. A participant's ignorance of an element is art. 20's (fork F-g1a-20).

units.title: Casos de impunibilidade
units.note: `o ajuste, a determinação ou instigação e o auxílio não são puníveis (art. 31)`: where the crime did not reach, at least, an attempt in art. 14, II's sense (fork F-g1a-17: the executor's desistance), save an express provision to the contrary (an input from the Parte Especial, e.g. arts. 286 and 288).

units.title: DAS ESPÉCIES DE PENA
units.note: Encoded whole by g0 in cp-pena.l4, § 'Art. 32 — Espécies de pena': the enum `Espécie de pena` and `as espécies de pena (art. 32)`.

units.title: Reclusão e detenção
units.note: Caput and § 1º by g0 in cp-pena.l4. §§ 2º–3º by g1b: `os regimes iniciais admissíveis (art. 33, §§ 2º e 3º)` returns the regimes the judge may fix, mildest first — the one the penalty permits by § 2º, a–c (detenção never starting closed, fork F-g1b-01; a reincidente at four years or less admitted to the semi-aberto on favourable art. 59 circumstances, Súmula 269 STJ, fork F-sweep-a-10), and a harsher one only on a concrete ground (Súmulas 718/719 STF, 440 STJ, fork F-sweep-a-09). § 4º: `o art. 33, § 4º, não impede a progressão`, for crimes against the public administration from 13.11.2003 (Lei 10.763). The progression 'segundo o mérito' is the LEP's, outside the source.

units.title: Regras do regime fechado
units.note: Encoded: the classification exam at the start of the closed regime (`o exame criminológico de classificação no início (arts. 34 e 35)`); §§ 1º–3º carried as the regime's rules in the Code's words (`as regras do regime (arts. 34 a 36)`), which nothing computes from.

units.title: Regras do regime semi-aberto
units.note: Encoded: art. 34's exam extended to a start in the semi-aberto; §§ 1º–2º carried as the regime's rules in the Code's words.

units.title: Regras do regime aberto
units.note: Encoded: § 2º's three causes of transfer out of the open regime (`o condenado será transferido do regime aberto (art. 36, § 2º)`), as the execution judge's findings; caput and § 1º carried as the regime's rules in the Code's words.

units.title: Regime especial
units.note: Encoded: `cumpre pena em estabelecimento próprio (art. 37)` reads the person's sex from cp-dominio's Pessoa; the rest of the article (duties and rights of her condition) is carried in its comment.

units.title: Direitos do preso
units.note: Carried as the Code's words (`os direitos do preso (art. 38)`): a statement of the prisoner's retained rights, which gates no decision in the Code and computes nothing.

units.title: Trabalho do preso
units.note: Carried as the Code's words (`o trabalho do preso (art. 39)`): the prisoner's work is paid and carries social security; no rule of the Code reads it.

units.title: Legislação especial
units.note: Carried as the Code's words (`a legislação especial (art. 40)`): a pointer to special legislation (the Lei de Execução Penal), outside the source.

units.title: Superveniência de doença mental
units.note: Encoded: `o recolhimento do condenado (art. 41)` gives the custody hospital, or failing one another suitable establishment, when mental illness supervenes; NOTHING when it does not.

units.title: Detração
units.note: Encoded: detração. Each period of provisional detention (in Brazil or abroad), administrative detention or committal counts in whole days, first and last included (art. 10; fork F-g1b-04), and `a pena a cumprir depois da detração (art. 42)` subtracts them from the custodial penalty or the security measure's term, never below zero.

units.title: Penas restritivas de direitos
units.note: Encoded whole by g0 in cp-pena.l4, § 'Art. 43 — Penas restritivas de direitos': the enum `Pena restritiva de direitos` (five species) and the six incisos in order; III and VI name the same species (fork F-g0-11).

units.title: (sem rubrica própria; sob "Penas restritivas de direitos", art. 43)
units.note: Encoded whole: `cabe a substituição (art. 44)` joins I (four years and no violence or grave threat, or any culposo crime: forks F-g1b-06, F-g1b-07), II (not reincidente between dolosos: F-g1b-08) or § 3º (socially advisable, not by the same offence: F-g1b-09), and III (the judge's finding); § 2º's forms as options; § 4º's conversion with the thirty-day floor; § 5º's power as options. § 1º is VETADO. Refuses for facts before 26.11.1998 (Lei 9.714's wording; the earlier one is not in the source). Súmula 588 STJ (M-sweep-a-39) is subsumed in I.

units.title: Conversão das penas restritivas de direitos
units.note: Encoded whole: § 1º's limits of the prestação pecuniária (1 to 360 minimum wages, the wage an input: fork F-g1b-10) and the deduction from a civil award; § 2º's other kind of payment on the beneficiary's acceptance; § 3º's ceiling (the greater of damage and proceeds) and destination. The caput is a pointer to arts. 46–48. § 4º is VETADO.

units.title: Prestação de serviços à comunidade ou a entidades públicas
units.note: Encoded whole: available for penalties over six months (caput); §§ 1º–2º carried in the Code's words; § 3º's hours, one per calendar day of the term counted by art. 10 (fork F-g1b-11); § 4º's minimum of half the penalty when it exceeds a year.

units.title: Interdição temporária de direitos (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)
units.note: Encoded whole: the five interdições as an enum, and `as interdições temporárias de direitos (art. 47)` lists those that existed on the date of the fact (IV from Lei 9.714/1998, V from Lei 12.550/2011, in force 16.12.2011).

units.title: Limitação de fim de semana
units.note: Encoded whole: Saturdays and Sundays, five hours a day; the place and the parágrafo único's courses carried in the Code's words.

units.title: Multa
units.note: Encoded whole by g0 in cp-pena.l4, § 'Art. 49 — Multa': the dias-multa limits (caput), the value of the dia-multa against the highest monthly minimum wage in force at the time of the fact (§ 1º, an input), and the update by a correction index (§ 2º, an input).

units.title: Pagamento da multa
units.note: Encoded whole: the last day to pay, the tenth day after the trânsito (fork F-g1b-19); the judge's power to allow monthly instalments on the convict's request; § 1º's three cases of collection by deduction; § 2º's protection of the resources indispensable to the convict and family (the judge's finding, an input).

units.title: Conversão da Multa e revogação (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)
units.note: Encoded as the two binding readings: ADI 3.150 (M-sweep-a-02) — from 13.12.2018 the Ministério Público has priority standing before the execution court; ADI 7.032 (M-sweep-a-03) — from 22.3.2024 a fine imposed with a custodial penalty and unpaid bars the declaration of extinction of punibilidade unless inability to pay, even in instalments, is proven. Each arm keyed on the day of the decision; before it the rule refuses by name (the text does not answer, and art. 51's earlier wording is not in the source). The dívida-ativa rules it borrows are outside the source. §§ 1º–2º revoked by Lei 9.268/1996.

units.title: Suspensão da execução da multa
units.note: Encoded: the execution of the fine is suspended when mental illness supervenes.

units.title: Penas privativas de liberdade
units.note: Encoded whole by g0 in cp-pena.l4, § 'Art. 53 — A pena cominada': the record `Pena cominada` is the sanção each tipo establishes, and `a quantidade está nos limites da pena cominada (art. 53)` tests a quantity against it.

units.title: Penas restritivas de direitos
units.note: Encoded: a restritiva needs no cominação in the Parte Especial (`a pena restritiva dispensa cominação na parte especial (art. 54)` reads nothing of the preceito); the printed condition 'inferior a 1 (um) ano, ou nos crimes culposos' is encoded as printed and superseded for the quantity by art. 44, I (Lei 9.714/1998), which is the operative test (fork F-g1b-20, witness in the tests).

units.title: Penas restritivas de direitos
units.note: Encoded: incisos III–VI of art. 43 last as long as the penalty replaced; I and II (the pecuniary ones) have no duration (NOTHING); the ressalva of art. 46 § 4º is `o tempo mínimo da prestação de serviços (art. 46, § 4º)`.

units.title: Penas restritivas de direitos
units.note: Encoded: interdições I and II of art. 47 apply to a crime classified as committed in the exercise of a profession, office or function in breach of its duties; the list of interdições applicable to a crime reads it (fork F-g1b-21).

units.title: Penas restritivas de direitos
units.note: Encoded: interdição III of art. 47 (driving licence) applies to a negligent traffic crime. Traffic crimes' own suspension under the Código de Trânsito Brasileiro is outside the source.

units.title: Pena de multa
units.note: Caput by g0 in cp-pena.l4 (a fine fits a preceito only within art. 49's limits, none under 'sem multa'). Parágrafo único by g1b: the substitutive fine applies 'independentemente de cominação', bounded only by art. 49 (`a multa substitutiva cabe independentemente de cominação (art. 58, parágrafo único)`); its reference to 'o parágrafo único do art. 44', which no longer exists, is read as art. 44 § 2º (fork F-g1b-22).

units.title: Fixação da pena
units.note: Encoded: the eight circumstances are the judge's valuations (`Circunstâncias judiciais`); I — the penalties applicable among those prescribed, as options (species where the preceito leaves it, fine where alternative); II — the pena-base range, the cominated limits; what the valuation may rest on: only final convictions, no five-year limit, never pending inquiries, never the conviction that is the reincidência (Súmulas 241 and 444 STJ, RE 593.818: forks F-sweep-a-02, F-sweep-a-03); ADPF 1.107 as a dated arm on the victim's behaviour in crimes against sexual dignity (M-sweep-a-04; fork F-g1b-23); III — the regimes of art. 33 §§ 2º–3º; IV — the substitutions of arts. 44 and 60 § 2º.

units.title: Critérios especiais da pena de multa
units.note: Encoded: caput (the economic situation) is the judge's; § 1º's increase up to triple, read on the value of the dia-multa (to fifteen minimum wages) on the judge's finding of ineffectiveness (fork F-g1b-24); § 2º's substitutive fine for penalties up to six months under art. 44's II and III only (fork F-g1b-25; witness in the tests).

units.title: Circunstâncias agravantes
units.note: Encoded whole: each inciso and alínea (I; II, a to m) is a predicate over the crime record, and `as circunstâncias agravantes (arts. 61 e 62)` lists those present, less those the crime record names as constituting or qualifying the crime (caput; fork F-g1b-12). Judgement words (fútil, torpe, abuso) are the court's findings, never computed. Vigência: II, f's violence-against-women limb from 22.9.2006 (Lei 11.340), II, h's 'mulher grávida' from 6.12.1996 (Lei 9.318) and 'maior de 60' from 1.1.2004 (Lei 10.741; before it the word was 'velho', which refuses), II, m from 4.7.2025 (Lei 15.159).

units.title: Agravantes no caso de concurso de pessoas
units.note: Encoded whole: I to III as the court's findings on the agent's role, IV as the cp-dominio means 'paga ou promessa de recompensa'; listed with art. 61's.

units.title: Reincidência
units.note: Encoded whole: a prior conviction generates reincidência if the new crime is on a later day than its trânsito em julgado (fork F-g1b-16), it was for a crime, and art. 64 does not take it out. 'no País ou no estrangeiro': both count (asserted). Computed from the agent's convictions; the tests cross-check it against cp-dominio's certified 'reincidente' (F-g0-05).

units.title: Reincidência
units.note: Encoded whole: I, the five years from the day the penalty was served or extinguished, or from the start of an unrevoked probation period, counted by art. 10 (fork F-g1b-17); II, military and political crimes do not count.

units.title: Circunstâncias atenuantes
units.note: Encoded whole: I computed from the agent's date of birth at the date of the fact (under 21) and of the sentence (70 or more), with Lei 15.160/2025's exception for crimes involving sexual violence against a woman on both limbs (fork F-g1b-15) and only for facts from 4.7.2025; II and III a–e as the court's findings; III d distinguishes a full from a partial or qualified confession (Súmulas 545 and 630 STJ, revised 2025; fork F-sweep-a-11).

units.title: (sem rubrica própria; sob "Circunstâncias atenuantes", art. 65)
units.note: Encoded: the atenuante inominada is present when the court records the finding (the judge's power, 'poderá').

units.title: Concurso de circunstâncias agravantes e atenuantes
units.note: Encoded: which circumstances preponderate (fork F-g1b-18) and the direction and range the second phase then leaves to the judge, `a segunda fase (arts. 61 a 67)`, floored at the cominated minimum (Súmula 231 STJ, fork F-sweep-a-01) and capped at the maximum; STJ Tema 585 for reincidência against confession.

units.title: Cálculo da pena
units.note: Encoded: the three phases, each as the range the Code allows — pena-base (art. 59, II), the second phase under arts. 61–67 (`a segunda fase da sentença (art. 68)`), and the third with cp-pena's cascade; the parágrafo único's power as options (every cause; one increase; one decrease; both), keeping the cause that most increases or decreases (fork F-g1b-26), Parte Geral causes always applied; `a dosimetria respeita o art. 68` checks a sentence's recorded quantities against the three ranges. It never chooses a quantity (Súmula 443 STJ, M-sweep-a-40).

units.title: Concurso material
units.note: Encoded: the sum of the penalties, the order of execution (reclusão first, then the longer: fork F-g1b-33), § 1º (a penalty not suspended for one crime bars art. 44 substitution for the others), § 2º (compatible restritivas simultaneously, the rest successively; compatibility is the judge's). Lei 15.402/2026's art. 359-M-A, which bars this rule for Título XII Cap. II crimes in one context, is cross-referred in the module (M-sweep-a-08; F-sweep-c-05).

units.title: Concurso formal
units.note: Encoded: which rule applies (`a regra do concurso (arts. 69 a 71)`); concurso formal próprio as the graver penalty (by species, then length: fork F-g1b-27) increased by 1/6 to 1/2, both ends capped at art. 69's sum (parágrafo único); the impróprio (doloso, autonomous designs) cumulative. M-sweep-a-08 cross-referred.

units.title: Crime continuado
units.note: Encoded: the continued crime as the graver penalty increased by the fraction the reading gives — the Code's 1/6–2/3 range or Súmula 659 STJ's scale by number of crimes, both executable as an interpretation field, the latter taken (fork F-sweep-a-04, M-sweep-a-14); the parágrafo único's 'até o triplo' capped at art. 69's sum (art. 75 limits time served, not the penalty: fork F-g1b-28); the caput not capped (fork F-g1b-29); Súmula 497 STF's penalty for prescription without the increase (fork F-sweep-a-05).

units.title: Multas no concurso de crimes
units.note: Encoded: in every concurso, the continued crime included (fork F-g1b-30), each fine applied distinctly and whole; `o valor das multas no concurso (art. 72)` sums them.

units.title: Erro na execução
units.note: Encoded: the agent answers as for the person he meant to harm (art. 20 § 3º's qualities follow that person), and art. 70 applies if that person was hit too.

units.title: Resultado diverso do pretendido
units.note: Encoded: art. 70 if the intended result also occurred; else negligence if the different result is a negligent crime; else no liability for that result. What follows as to the intended crime the article does not say (fork F-g1b-31).

units.title: Limite das penas
units.note: Encoded: the forty-year limit and § 1º's unification, for crimes from 23.1.2020 (Lei 13.964/2019; the thirty-year wording is not in the source, so earlier crimes refuse by name); § 2º's new unification for a fact after serving began, from the total imposed less the time served (fork F-g1b-32); Súmula 715 STF — benefits on the total, not the unified penalty (fork F-sweep-a-08, M-sweep-a-20).

units.title: Concurso de infrações
units.note: Encoded: the graver penalty is executed first (`a ordem de execução (arts. 69 e 76)`, `a pena executada primeiro (art. 76)`).

units.title: Homicídio simples
units.note: Every paragraph: caput and § 3º (the crime, intentional — consummated or attempted, art. 14 — or culpable), § 1º (the privilege, a cause of decrease; fork F-g2a-01 on which qualifiers admit it, F-g2a-02 on 'pode'), § 2º I–X (the qualified form, one preceito for all ten incisos; VI revoked by Lei nº 14.994/2024 and shown '(Revogado)'), § 2º-B and § 2º-C (causes of increase), § 2º-D (qualified form, 20–40 years, from 25.3.2026), § 4º (both sentences; F-g2a-03 on § 4º's 'menor de 14' beside § 2º IX), § 5º (the judicial pardon, returned as an option), § 6º (cause; F-g2a-05 beside § 2º-D). § 2º-A and § 7º are '(Revogado)' in the source and carry no rule. Temporal scope: penalty rules answer for facts from 10.10.2024 (Lei nº 14.994/2024, which revoked § 2º VI, § 2º-A and § 7º) and refuse earlier; a fact before 7.5.2025 that only § 2º VII would qualify refuses (VII re-written by Lei nº 15.134/2025); § 2º X and § 2º-C apply from 4.7.2025, § 2º-D from 25.3.2026. Tests in cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4.

units.title: Feminicídio
units.note: Caput (the crime, consummated or attempted, from 10.10.2024), § 1º (the razões, as input findings; § 1º I read as Lei nº 11.340/2006 art. 5º defines it — reserved fork F-sweep-b-08, M-sweep-b-17), § 2º (one cause of 1/3 to 1/2 for any of I–V; V borrows the conditions of art. 121 § 2º III, IV and VIII and keeps its own fraction; F-g2a-06 on 'nos 3 meses posteriores ao parto'), § 3º (communication to the co-agent; F-g2a-07). Which of arts. 121, 121-A and 121-B governs a killing: F-g2a-04. Tests in cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4.

units.title: Vicaricídio
units.note: Caput (the crime, consummated or attempted, from 10.4.2026 — Lei nº 15.384/2026; before it the killing is art. 121's) and parágrafo único (one cause of 1/3 to 1/2 for any of I–III; criança, adolescente and idoso as cp-pena reads them, forks F-g0-24 and F-g0-08). Tests in cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4.

units.title: Induzimento, instigação ou auxílio a suicídio ou a automutilação
units.note: Caput (the crime, complete with the conduct since Lei nº 13.968/2019; its attempt is not modelled), §§ 1º and 2º (the results; § 1º's grades read through art. 129 §§ 1º–2º's incisos), §§ 3º to 5º (causes of increase; 'menor' in § 3º II read as under eighteen, fork F-g2a-20), §§ 6º and 7º (the agent answers for art. 129 § 2º or for homicide: the module builds that injury or killing from the same facts and asks cp-g2a-lesao-corporal / cp-g2a-homicidio, fork F-g2a-19). Temporal scope: everything refuses for a fact before 27.12.2019 (Lei nº 13.968/2019 re-wrote the article, definition included) and the causes refuse where § 5º bears before 15.1.2024 (Lei nº 14.811/2024); both dates are the DOU's, vigência asked of sweep-b. Tests in cp-g2a-suicidio-testes.l4.

units.title: Infanticídio
units.note: Encoded in cp-g2a-homicidio.l4 beside arts. 121 to 121-B, because the rule that says which article governs a death must be able to choose it (fork F-g2a-18): the crime (consummated or attempted, the puerperal state and the timing as input findings) and its pena. Unchanged since 1940, so not gated. Tests in cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4.

units.title: Aborto provocado pela gestante ou com seu consentimento
units.note: The pregnant woman's crime, consummated or attempted; identity of agent and pregnant woman by `identificação`. Read down by ADPF 54 for the anencephalic foetus from 12.4.2012 (binding entry M-sweep-b-01; fork F-g2a-22 on the date); art. 128 excuses it. Applies at every gestational age (reserved fork F-sweep-b-01; ADPF 442 pending, M-sweep-b-03). Tests in cp-g2a-aborto-testes.l4.

units.title: Aborto provocado por terceiro
units.note: The third party's crime without consent, consummated or attempted; art. 128 I reaches it (fork F-g2a-24). ADPF 54's ementa does not name art. 125: for an anencephalic foetus after 12.4.2012 the crime predicate REFUSES (fork F-g2a-23, open). Tests in cp-g2a-aborto-testes.l4.

units.title: Aborto provocado por terceiro, com o consentimento da gestante
units.note: The third party's crime with consent, consummated or attempted, read down by ADPF 54 (M-sweep-b-01); the parágrafo único is a preceito that points at art. 125's pena, applied for a pregnant woman not 'maior de quatorze anos' (cp-pena's `maior de`, F-g0-06), 'alienada ou debil mental', or whose consent was obtained by fraud, serious threat or violence. Tests in cp-g2a-aborto-testes.l4.

units.title: Forma qualificada
units.note: Two causes of increase on arts. 125 and 126 only: a third for a serious injury to the pregnant woman (the very serious grade included, fork F-g2a-21), doubling for her death (the doubling alone where both, fork F-g2a-25). Tests in cp-g2a-aborto-testes.l4.

units.title: Aborto necessário; aborto no caso de gravidez resultante de estupro
units.note: Both incisos, as an exclusion of punishment for the abortion itself (every participant; inciso I also without consent, fork F-g2a-24). 'praticado por médico' as written: ADPF 1207/989's liminar fell on 24.10.2025 (M-sweep-b-02, prospective). Tests in cp-g2a-aborto-testes.l4.

units.title: Lesão corporal
units.note: Every paragraph: caput and § 6º (the crime, intentional — consummated or attempted — or culpable; a death the agent wanted or risked is homicide, not art. 129), §§ 1º and 2º (the grades, computed from the incisos the medical report attests; `a natureza da lesão (art. 129, §§ 1º e 2º)` gives the shared Resultado, F-g2a-11), § 3º and § 3º-A (followed by death; § 3º-A from 25.3.2026), § 4º (cause of decrease), § 5º (the judge's option; its fine in réis is inert and the substituted fine is art. 49's day-fine — binding entry M-sweep-b-07), §§ 7º, 8º-A, 10, 11 and 12 (causes of increase; § 7º borrows the conditions of art. 121 §§ 4º and 6º and keeps its own 1/3, F-g2a-10), § 8º (art. 121 § 5º's pardon, as an option), §§ 9º and 13 (the domestic and gender forms of the slight injury, F-g2a-09). The ação penal, which the Code does not state, from Lei nº 9.099/1995 art. 88 and Lei nº 11.340/2006 art. 41 with STJ Súmula 542 (binding entry M-sweep-b-16, reserved fork F-sweep-b-07). Temporal scope: penalty rules answer from 10.10.2024 (Lei nº 14.994/2024 re-wrote § 9º's pena and § 13) and refuse earlier; a fact before 2.7.2026 on which § 9º bears refuses (§ 9º re-worded by Lei nº 15.455/2026), and so do the causes of a fact before 4.7.2025 on which § 12 bears (Lei nº 15.159/2025). Tests in cp-g2a-lesao-corporal-testes.l4.

units.title: Perigo de contágio venéreo
units.note: Caput and § 1º (the intentional form), their penas ('ou multa' / 'e multa'), and § 2º, the ação penal condicionada à representação, for the whole article (fork F-g2a-33). Tests in cp-g2a-periclitacao-testes.l4. The attempt is not modelled for the crimes of danger of Cap. III (art. 135 is omissive and has none).

units.title: Perigo de contágio de moléstia grave
units.note: The crime and its pena. Tests in cp-g2a-periclitacao-testes.l4. The attempt is not modelled for the crimes of danger of Cap. III (art. 135 is omissive and has none).

units.title: Perigo para a vida ou saúde de outrem
units.note: The crime, subsidiary: 'se o fato não constitui crime mais grave' is an input finding (fork F-g2a-26); the parágrafo único's increase of 1/6 to 1/3, from 30.12.1998 (Lei nº 9.777/1998, in force on publication, S-sweep-b-14). Tests in cp-g2a-periclitacao-testes.l4. The attempt is not modelled for the crimes of danger of Cap. III (art. 135 is omissive and has none).

units.title: Abandono de incapaz
units.note: The crime, the three penas as Lei nº 15.163/2025 wrote them, and § 3º's increase (I lugar ermo; II the relationships named, not the companheiro, fork F-g2a-29; III over sixty, cp-pena's maior de). Penalty rules refuse for a fact before 4.7.2025 (Lei nº 15.163/2025, S-sweep-b-02); the definition answers for any date. 'lesão corporal de natureza grave' includes the very serious grade (F-g2a-21); the death alone where both (F-g2a-25). Tests in cp-g2a-periclitacao-testes.l4. The attempt is not modelled for the crimes of danger of Cap. III (art. 135 is omissive and has none).

units.title: Exposição ou abandono de recém-nascido
units.note: The crime ('recém-nascido' a finding, fork F-g2a-28) and its three penas by result. Tests in cp-g2a-periclitacao-testes.l4. The attempt is not modelled for the crimes of danger of Cap. III (art. 135 is omissive and has none).

units.title: Omissão de socorro
units.note: The crime: its three victims (fork F-g2a-32; 'criança' as cp-pena's, F-g0-24) and its two conducts (help where possible without personal risk, else ask the authority, fork F-g2a-27); the pena ('ou multa'); the parágrafo único's increases (half; triple for death). Tests in cp-g2a-periclitacao-testes.l4. The attempt is not modelled for the crimes of danger of Cap. III (art. 135 is omissive and has none).

units.title: Condicionamento de atendimento médico-hospitalar emergencial
units.note: The crime, from 29.5.2012 (Lei nº 12.653/2012, in force on publication, S-sweep-b-14); its pena ('e multa'); the parágrafo único's increases (up to double; up to triple for death). Tests in cp-g2a-periclitacao-testes.l4. The attempt is not modelled for the crimes of danger of Cap. III (art. 135 is omissive and has none).

units.title: Maus-tratos
units.note: The crime (one of its three modes), the three penas as Lei nº 15.163/2025 wrote them, and § 3º's increase for a victim under fourteen. Penalty rules refuse for a fact before 4.7.2025. Tests in cp-g2a-periclitacao-testes.l4. The attempt is not modelled for the crimes of danger of Cap. III (art. 135 is omissive and has none).

units.title: Rixa
units.note: The crime (a rixa of three or more, fork F-g2a-30; not the one who takes part only to separate the fighters) and its two penas: the caput's, and the parágrafo único's own preceito where a death or serious injury occurs (every participant, except one who joined after it, fork F-g2a-31). Unchanged since 1940. Tests in cp-g2a-rixa-testes.l4.

units.title: Calúnia
units.note: Encoded whole in cp-g2b-honra.l4, § 'Art. 138 — Calúnia': caput and § 1º (the crime, consummated or attempted, art. 14; consummated when the imputation reaches a third person, fork F-g2b-02), § 2º (calúnia against the dead), the pena cominada, and § 3º (whether the exceção da verdade is admitted, incisos I to III). A legal person as victim refuses (fork F-g2b-01, open). Tests in cp-g2b-honra-testes.l4.

units.title: Difamação
units.note: Encoded whole in cp-g2b-honra.l4, § 'Art. 139 — Difamação': the crime (consummated or attempted), less art. 142's exclusions, its pena cominada, and the parágrafo único (exceção da verdade for a public official offended in relation to their functions; 'funcionário público' read from art. 327's facts). Tests in cp-g2b-honra-testes.l4.

units.title: Injúria
units.note: Encoded whole in cp-g2b-honra.l4, § 'Art. 140 — Injúria': caput (the crime, consummated or attempted, less art. 142's exclusions and the injúria racial displaced to Lei nº 7.716/1989, art. 2º-A: M-sweep-b-20, F-sweep-b-11 settled by MI 4733 ED), § 1º (the judge's option not to apply the penalty, F-g2b-09), § 2º (injúria real, with the violence's penalty as well) and § 3º (redação da Lei nº 14.532/2023; its penalty refuses for facts before 11.1.2023, whose wording is not in the source). The heaviest form present governs. Tests in cp-g2b-honra-testes.l4.

units.title: Disposições comuns
units.note: Encoded whole in cp-g2b-honra.l4, § 'Art. 141 — Disposições comuns': the one-third increase of the caput (I; II, the public-official limb from 1940 and the Presidents from 1.12.2021, F-g2b-07; III; IV in the redação of Lei nº 14.344/2022, from 9.7.2022, refusing before it where IV's people are the victims, with the exception for art. 140 § 3º), § 1º (double), § 2º (triple, from 30.5.2021, F-g2b-04) and § 3º (double, from 10.10.2024), each as a cause with its fraction; the limits with the causes and the attempt; a stated reading that the increases reach the fine (F-g2b-08). ADPF 338 upheld II (M-sweep-b-44). Tests in cp-g2b-honra-testes.l4.

units.title: Exclusão do crime
units.note: Encoded whole in cp-g2b-honra.l4, § 'Art. 142 — Exclusão do crime': incisos I to III and the parágrafo único (the one who gives publicity answers), applied inside the difamação and injúria predicates, not to calúnia. Inciso I as written; the EOAB immunity was revoked (M-sweep-b-15, no effect). Tests in cp-g2b-honra-testes.l4.

units.title: Retratação
units.note: Encoded whole in cp-g2b-honra.l4, § 'Art. 143 — Retratação': the exemption from penalty for full retraction before the sentence, in calúnia and difamação, in the private action (fork F-g2b-11), and the parágrafo único's form (retraction by the same means where the offended wishes it), from 12.11.2015 (Lei nº 13.188/2015). Art. 107, VI is g1c's. Tests in cp-g2b-honra-testes.l4.

units.title: Retratação
units.note: Encoded in cp-g2b-honra.l4, § 'Art. 144 — Pedido de explicações': when the one who feels offended may ask for explanations in court, and when the one asked answers for the offence (which still needs arts. 138 to 140's elements). The source prints no heading of its own for art. 144; the title here is the mechanical one of the roadmap. Tests in cp-g2b-honra-testes.l4.

units.title: Retratação
units.note: Encoded whole in cp-g2b-honra.l4, § 'Art. 145 — Ação penal': the private action by default; the exception of injúria real with lesão corporal (public and unconditional for serious injury or death; for slight injury refused, fork F-g2b-06 open, M-sweep-b-16); the parágrafo único (requisição for art. 141, I; representação for art. 141, II and art. 140, § 3º), in the redação of Lei nº 12.033/2009, refusing before 30.9.2009 where it would decide; Súmula 714 STF's concurrent queixa for the public official offended because of their functions (F-sweep-b-12, settled; M-sweep-b-21). Returned as the list of routes open. The source prints no heading of its own for art. 145. Tests in cp-g2b-honra-testes.l4.

units.title: Constrangimento ilegal
units.note: Encoded whole in cp-g2b-constrangimento-ameaca.l4, § 'Art. 146 — Constrangimento ilegal': the crime (consummated when the victim does or omits; attempted otherwise, art. 14), § 3º's exclusions, the pena cominada carrying § 2º (the violence's penalty as well), § 1º as the fine made cumulative plus a doubling cause (PLAN shape 2a; 'mais de três pessoas' counts everyone who took part, F-g2b-13; 'armas' any weapon, F-g2b-05), with a stated reading that the doubling reaches the fine (F-g2b-08), and the limits with causes and attempt. Tests in cp-g2b-constrangimento-ameaca-testes.l4.

units.title: Intimidação sistemática (bullying)
units.note: Encoded whole in cp-g2b-constrangimento-ameaca.l4, § 'Art. 146-A — Intimidação sistemática (bullying)': the crime from 15.1.2024 (Lei nº 14.811/2024), subsidiary to a graver crime (a finding, F-g2b-12), habitual and so without attempt (F-g2b-10); its preceito secundário as `Preceito secundário` — only a fine (caput), or reclusão 2–4 years and a fine for the digital form (parágrafo único). Tests in cp-g2b-constrangimento-ameaca-testes.l4.

units.title: Ameaça
units.note: Encoded whole in cp-g2b-constrangimento-ameaca.l4, § 'Art. 147 — Ameaça': the crime (consummated or attempted), the pena cominada, § 1º (double, against a woman for reasons of the female condition, from 10.10.2024; art. 121-A § 1º read through the noun, F-sweep-b-08 being g2a's) and § 2º's ação penal (representação, unconditional in § 1º's case), refusing before 10.10.2024 because the parágrafo único then in force is not in the source. Tests in cp-g2b-constrangimento-ameaca-testes.l4.

units.title: Perseguição
units.note: Encoded whole in cp-g2b-constrangimento-ameaca.l4, § 'Art. 147-A — Perseguição': the crime from 1.4.2021 (Lei nº 14.132/2021), habitual and without attempt (F-g2b-10); the pena cominada carrying § 2º; § 1º's half increase (I, II, III); § 3º's representação. § 1º II cites the revoked art. 121 § 2º-A (M-sweep-b-46): fork F-sweep-b-24 created and taken as the sweep suggests — inapplicable from 10.10.2024, refused before it where II's facts decide the increase. Tests in cp-g2b-constrangimento-ameaca-testes.l4.

units.title: (Incluído pela Lei nº 14.188, de 2021)
units.note: Encoded whole in cp-g2b-constrangimento-ameaca.l4, § 'Art. 147-B — Violência psicológica contra a mulher': the crime from 29.7.2021 (Lei nº 14.188/2021), consummated or attempted, subsidiary to a graver crime (F-g2b-12); the pena cominada; the parágrafo único's half increase from 25.4.2025 (Lei nº 15.123/2025). Tests in cp-g2b-constrangimento-ameaca-testes.l4.

units.title: (Incluído pela Lei nº 14.188, de 2021)
units.note: Encoded whole in cp-g2b-constrangimento-ameaca.l4, § 'Art. 147-C — Ameaça no contexto do crime organizado': the crime from 25.3.2026 (Lei nº 15.358/2026), over art. 147's facts plus the context circumstance, which the fact supplier certifies (M-sweep-b-43); its pena cominada (reclusão 1–3 years, no fine) and the attempt's limits. Art. 147 is reported beside it (F-g2b-03). Tests in cp-g2b-constrangimento-ameaca-testes.l4.

units.title: Seqüestro e cárcere privado
units.note: Encoded whole in cp-g2b-sequestro-escravidao.l4, § 'Art. 148 — Seqüestro e cárcere privado': the crime (consummated or attempted), the caput's pena, § 1º (I in the redação of Lei nº 11.106/2005, refusing before 29.3.2005 where I decides; II and III from 1940, the days counted as art. 10 counts them, F-g2b-14; IV and V from 29.3.2005), § 2º and § 3º (from 25.3.2026, Lei nº 15.358/2026; membership and context certified facts, M-sweep-b-43); the heaviest form present governs; the attempt's limits. Vide V24 (Lei nº 10.446/2002) is investigative competence only, no effect. Tests in cp-g2b-sequestro-escravidao-testes.l4.

units.title: Redução a condição análoga à de escravo
units.note: Encoded whole in cp-g2b-sequestro-escravidao.l4, § 'Art. 149 — Redução a condição análoga à de escravo': the crime in the redação of Lei nº 10.803/2003 (refused for facts before 12.12.2003, whose wording is not in the source), the four caput modes as alternatives with the judge's finding that the breach is intense and persistent (F-sweep-b-10 settled by STF Inq 3412, M-sweep-b-19), § 1º I and II, the pena (with the violence's penalty as well), § 2º's half increase (I, II), and the limits with causes and attempt. Tests in cp-g2b-sequestro-escravidao-testes.l4.

units.title: Tráfico de Pessoas (Incluído pela Lei nº 13.344, de 2016) (Vigência)
units.note: Encoded whole in cp-g2b-sequestro-escravidao.l4, § 'Art. 149-A — Tráfico de pessoas': the crime from 21.11.2016 (Lei nº 13.344/2016, 45 days of vacatio), consummated or attempted; the pena cominada; § 1º's increase of one third to one half (I, with 'funcionário público' read from art. 327's facts; II; III, F-g2b-15 on which relations count; IV) and § 2º's reduction of one to two thirds (primário and not in a criminal organisation, F-g0-05); the limits with every cause and the attempt. Tests in cp-g2b-sequestro-escravidao-testes.l4.

units.title: Violação de domicílio
units.note: Encoded whole in cp-g2b-domicilio.l4, § 'Art. 150 — Violação de domicílio': the crime (consummated or attempted), 'casa' by §§ 4º and 5º (with § 5º I's restriction), § 3º's exclusions (II split by the agent's status, F-sweep-b-05, M-sweep-b-13), § 1º's qualified form (night, deserted place, violence against a person or a thing F-g2b-16, weapon F-g2b-05, two or more people), and § 2º's revocation by Lei nº 13.869/2019 (in force 3.1.2020): no causes of increase since, refused before for a public official acting as such. From 3.1.2020 a public agent's entry in the function is Lei nº 13.869, art. 22, not art. 150 (F-sweep-b-04, M-sweep-b-12). Tests in cp-g2b-domicilio-testes.l4.

units.title: Violação de correspondência
units.note: Encoded whole in cp-g2b-correspondencia.l4, § 'Art. 151 — Violação de correspondência': caput and § 1º I–IV (consummated or attempted), § 2º's half increase (reaching the caput and § 1º, not § 3º: F-g2b-17), § 3º's qualified form, and § 4º's ação penal. Where Lei nº 6.538/1978 (postal) or Lei nº 9.472/1997 (clandestine telecoms) may have displaced it — caput and § 1º I for postal correspondence, § 1º IV for a clandestine telecoms activity — the crime predicate refuses: fork F-sweep-b-06 left open (M-sweep-b-14). Tests in cp-g2b-correspondencia-testes.l4.

units.title: Correspondência comercial
units.note: Encoded whole in cp-g2b-correspondencia.l4, § 'Art. 152 — Correspondência comercial': the crime (consummated or attempted), its pena cominada (detenção, no fine) and the parágrafo único's representação. Tests in cp-g2b-correspondencia-testes.l4.

units.title: Divulgação de segredo
units.note: Encoded whole in cp-g2b-segredos.l4, § 'Art. 153 — Divulgação de segredo': caput and § 1º-A (from 15.10.2000, Lei nº 9.983/2000), consummated or attempted; the penalties, the caput's réis amount cancelled by Lei nº 7.209/1984 art. 2º and written as the alternative fine (M-sweep-b-07, binding; the rule-version arm implemented: penalties refuse for facts before 13.1.1985); § 1º's representação (reaching § 1º-A, F-g2b-18) and § 2º's unconditional action where the Administration is harmed. Tests in cp-g2b-segredos-testes.l4.

units.title: Violação do segredo profissional
units.note: Encoded whole in cp-g2b-segredos.l4, § 'Art. 154 — Violação do segredo profissional': the crime (consummated or attempted), the pena with the réis amount cancelled (M-sweep-b-07; refused before 13.1.1985) and the parágrafo único's representação. Tests in cp-g2b-segredos-testes.l4.

units.title: Vigência
units.note: Encoded whole in cp-g2b-segredos.l4, § 'Art. 154-A — Invasão de dispositivo informático': caput and § 1º in the redação of Lei nº 14.155/2021 (no crime before 2.4.2013, when Lei nº 12.737/2012 created it; refused from 2.4.2013 to 27.5.2021, the earlier wording not being in the source), consummated or attempted; § 3º's qualified form; the causes of §§ 2º (not on § 3º, F-g2b-19), 4º (on § 3º only) and 5º (the office-holders I–IV); the limits with causes and attempt. Tests in cp-g2b-segredos-testes.l4.

units.title: Vigência
units.note: Encoded whole in cp-g2b-segredos.l4, § 'Art. 154-B — Ação penal': representação, save against the direct or indirect public administration or a public-service concession company (then public and unconditional, art. 100). Tests in cp-g2b-segredos-testes.l4.

units.title: Furto
units.note: Encoded by g0 as the worked pattern; owned by g3 from here. Every paragraph: caput and § 3º (the crime, consummated or attempted, art. 14), § 1º (increase), § 2º (privileged: the judge's three options), §§ 4º, 4º-A, 4º-B, 5º to 10 (the qualified forms and their penas cominadas), § 4º-C, § 11 and § 12 (causes of increase). Temporal scope: penalty rules answer for facts from 4.5.2026 (Lei nº 15.397/2026) and refuse for earlier facts, whose wording is not in the source; §§ 10 to 12 apply from 23.9.2026 (Lei nº 15.517/2026). Tests in cp-g3-furto-testes.l4. Forks in g0.forks.json: the reserved F-sweep-b-17 to F-sweep-b-21 (sweep entries M-sweep-b-26 to -30), and F-g0-05, -13, -14, -18 to -21, -23, -25 to -27. The insignificância principle is an input finding (F-sweep-b-21).

units.title: Furto de coisa comum
units.note: Caput (the crime, consummated or attempted, art. 14), § 1º (ação penal condicionada à representação: a ação penal do art. 156), § 2º (not punishable: fungible and worth no more than the agent's share), and the pena (detenção 6 meses a 2 anos, ou multa). 1940 text, answers for any date. Art. 183-A is its only cause. Tests in cp-g3-furto-testes.l4. Fork F-g3-04 (the common thing must be movable).

units.title: Roubo
units.note: Every paragraph: caput and § 1º (roubo próprio and impróprio, consummated per Súmula 582 STJ, attempted), § 1º-A, § 2º I (revoked) to XI (one cause, 1/3 to 1/2), § 2º-A I to III (2/3; alínea e vetoed), § 2º-B and § 4º (the caput pena doubled and tripled, as candidate penas; under § 4º other causes disregarded), § 3º I and II (latrocínio consummated per Súmula 610, attempted when violence meant to kill), § 5º. The heaviest candidate governs (F-g3-09). Penalty rules refuse before 4.5.2026 (Lei 15.397/2026); § 2º XI and § 2º-A III from 23.9.2026. Art. 183-A among the causes. Tests in cp-g3-roubo-testes.l4. Forks F-sweep-b-02, -14, -15; F-g3-05 to F-g3-10. Pending vetoes VET 20/2026 and VET 52/2026 noted, encoded as compiled.

units.title: Extorsão
units.note: Caput (formal crime: Súmula 96 STJ, F-sweep-b-16; attempted), § 1º (1/3 to 1/2: two or more people, or any weapon, F-g3-11, F-g3-12; reaches only the caput, F-g3-13), § 2º (art. 157 § 3º penalties, refusing before 4.5.2026), § 3º (6–12 além da multa, from 17.4.2009; with injury or death, art. 159 §§ 2º–3º penalties; special over § 2º, F-g3-13), § 4º (tripling of the respective penalty, from 25.3.2026; read with its siblings, F-sweep-b-22). Art. 183-A among the causes. Tests in cp-g3-extorsao-testes.l4.

units.title: Extorsão mediante seqüestro
units.note: Caput (8–15, no fine), § 1º (over 24 hours; victim under 18 or 60 and over; bando ou quadrilha read as associação criminosa, F-g3-14), § 2º (serious injury, 16–24), § 3º (death, 24–30), § 4º (reduction 1/3 to 2/3 for the reporting accomplice), § 5º (2/3, from 25.3.2026). Penalty rules refuse before 10.8.2009, when Lei 8.072/1990 art. 9º could still apply on the revoked art. 224 (F-sweep-b-02, settled). Art. 183-A among the causes.

units.title: Extorsão indireta
units.note: Demanding or receiving a document as security for a debt, abusing someone's situation (the judge's finding), consummated or attempted (F-g3-15); pena reclusão 1–3 e multa; 1940 text. Art. 183-A its only cause.

units.title: Alteração de limites
units.note: Caput (alteração de limites), § 1º I (usurpação de águas), § 1º II (esbulho possessório; "mais de duas pessoas" = three or more, F-g3-16), consummated or attempted; pena detenção 1–6 meses e multa; § 2º (the violence's penalty too, violence to the person, F-g3-17); § 3º (queixa if private property and no violence; else art. 100's public action). 1940 text. Art. 183-A its only cause.

units.title: Supressão ou alteração de marca em animais
units.note: Removing or altering, without right (the judge's finding), a brand or sign of ownership on another's herd, consummated or attempted; detenção 6 meses a 3 anos e multa. 1940 text. Art. 183-A its only cause.

units.title: Dano
units.note: Caput (dano, consummated or attempted; detenção 1–6 meses ou multa) and parágrafo único I–IV (detenção 6 meses–3 anos e multa, além da pena correspondente à violência). II's "se o fato não constitui crime mais grave" is an input finding (F-g3-20). III refuses for a fact before 8.12.2017 (Lei 13.531/2017), reached only where III decides. Art. 183-A its only cause.

units.title: Introdução ou abandono de animais em propriedade alheia
units.note: Putting or leaving animals on another's property without consent, loss resulting (an element: no attempt); detenção 15 dias–6 meses ou multa; queixa (art. 167).

units.title: Dano em coisa de valor artístico, arqueológico ou histórico
units.note: Damage to a thing listed for artistic, archaeological or historic value, consummated or attempted; detenção 6 meses–2 anos e multa. Possible tacit revocation by Lei 9.605/1998 art. 62 recorded as fork F-g3-18, not taken.

units.title: Alteração de local especialmente protegido
units.note: Altering without licence a place specially protected by law; detenção 1 mês–1 ano ou multa. Lei 9.605/1998 art. 63: fork F-g3-18.

units.title: Ação penal
units.note: Queixa for the simple dano, the dano qualified by IV alone (F-g3-19), and art. 164; the other qualified dano is public (art. 100).

units.title: Apropriação indébita
units.note: Caput (consummated or attempted; reclusão 1–4 e multa) and § 1º I–III (1/3). Art. 170's privilege and art. 183-A. 1940 text.

units.title: Apropriação indébita previdenciária (Incluído pela Lei nº 9.983, de 2000)
units.note: Caput and § 1º I–III (omission; reclusão 2–5 e multa), from 15.10.2000 (Lei 9.983/2000, computed, F-g3-03); § 2º and Lei 10.684/2003 art. 9º § 2º (payment at any time, M-sweep-b-11, F-sweep-b-03 settled by STF RHC 128.245/SP) extinguish punishability; §§ 5º–6º carve out the devedor contumaz for acts from 9.1.2026; § 3º options (no penalty, or fine only) and § 4º (from 10.1.2018). Art. 170 applied (F-g3-21).

units.title: Apropriação de coisa havida por erro, caso fortuito ou força da natureza
units.note: Caput (thing come by mistake, accident or natural force), p.ú. I (treasure: the owner's share), p.ú. II (found thing not returned within fifteen days, counted as art. 10 counts, F-g3-22); detenção 1 mês–1 ano ou multa. Art. 170's privilege without the reclusão option (F-g3-23).

units.title: Aplicação do art. 155, § 2º, aos crimes do Capítulo V
units.note: Art. 155 § 2º's options for arts. 168, 168-A (F-g3-21) and 169 (F-g3-23), returned as options, never chosen.

units.title: Estelionato
units.note: Caput (consummated or attempted), § 1º (art. 155 § 2º options; not on § 2º-A, F-g3-25), § 2º I–VII (VII from 4.5.2026; VI needs fraud, Súmula 246, and payment before the denúncia bars the action, Súmula 554 a contrario: F-sweep-b-13), § 2º-A (4–8), § 2º-B (1/3–2/3, on § 2º-A), § 3º (1/3; Súmula 24 STJ; public foundations included, F-g3-24), § 4º (1/3 to double, older or vulnerable victim), § 5º revoked (ação penal pública incondicionada from 4.5.2026, art. 100). Penalty, options and ação penal refuse before 4.5.2026 (Lei 15.397/2026). Art. 183-A among the causes.

units.title: Fraude com ativos virtuais, valores mobiliários ou ativos financeiros (sem rubrica no texto)
units.note: Fraudulent portfolios or operations with virtual assets, securities or financial assets (a formal crime, F-g3-26), from 20.6.2023 (Lei 14.478/2022 art. 14); reclusão 4–8 e multa. Art. 183-A its only cause.

units.title: Duplicata simulada
units.note: Caput (redação da Lei 8.137/1990, refusing before 28.12.1990) and parágrafo único; detenção 2–4 anos e multa. Consummated conduct only (F-g3-28).

units.title: Abuso de incapazes
units.note: Abuse of a minor's need, passion or inexperience ("menor" = under 18, F-g3-27) or of another's mental alienation or weakness, inducing an act with legal effect to someone's loss; reclusão 2–6 e multa.

units.title: Induzimento à especulação
units.note: Inducing gambling, betting or speculation by abusing inexperience, simplicity or mental inferiority, knowing or bound to know it ruinous; reclusão 1–3 e multa.

units.title: Fraude no comércio
units.note: Caput I–II (detenção 6 meses–2 anos ou multa), § 1º (reclusão 1–5 e multa; the source's "metal de ou outra qualidade" read as "de outra qualidade", F-g3-29), § 2º (art. 155 § 2º options; no reclusão to replace on the caput, as F-g3-23).

units.title: Outras fraudes
units.note: Meal, lodging or transport without the means to pay; detenção 15 dias–2 meses ou multa; parágrafo único: representação, and the judge's power not to impose the penalty returned as an option.

units.title: Fraudes e abusos na fundação ou administração de sociedade por ações
units.note: Caput and § 1º I–IX (each inciso with the roles it names; VIII the liquidator for I–V and VII; IV's "salvo quando a lei o permite"), subsidiary to a crime against the popular economy (an input, M-sweep-b-09); reclusão 1–4 e multa; § 2º (shareholder trading his vote), detenção 6 meses–2 anos e multa.

units.title: Emissão irregular de conhecimento de depósito ou "warrant"
units.note: Issuing a warehouse receipt or warrant against a legal provision (an input finding); reclusão 1–4 e multa.

units.title: Fraude à execução
units.note: Defrauding an execution by disposing of, diverting, destroying or damaging assets, or feigning debts; detenção 6 meses–2 anos ou multa; queixa.

units.title: Receptação
units.note: Caput (própria and imprópria), § 1º (commercial or industrial activity; "deve saber" includes "sabe", F-g3-30), § 2º (irregular trade equated), § 3º (culpable; detenção 1 mês–1 ano, ou multa, ou ambas), § 4º (declaratory: nothing reads the prior author), § 5º revoked (no option since), §§ 6º and 7º (doubling on the caput's, or the caput's or § 1º's, penalty, F-g3-31), § 8º (2/3). Crime predicates from 26.12.1996 (Lei 9.426/1996 art. 2º, read on Planalto); penalties, causes and options refuse before 4.5.2026. Art. 183-A among the causes.

units.title: Receptação de animal
units.note: Receiving farm or domestic animals for production or trade, knowing or bound to know their criminal origin; reclusão 3–8 e multa; caput and pena re-written by Lei 15.397/2026: refuses before 4.5.2026. Art. 183-A its only cause.

units.title: Isenção de pena (Disposições gerais)
units.note: I (spouse during the conjugal society; the de facto separated included, F-g3-01; the companheiro refused, F-sweep-b-09) and II (ascendant or descendant). Tests in cp-g3-disposicoes-gerais-testes.l4.

units.title: Ação penal condicionada à representação (Disposições gerais)
units.note: I (desquitado or judicially separated; deed-separated and divorced spouses refused, F-sweep-b-23), II (sibling), III (uncle or nephew living with the agent); and how it conditions an offence's own ação penal.

units.title: Exceções aos arts. 181 e 182 (Disposições gerais)
units.note: I (roubo or extorsão — arts. 157 to 160, F-g3-02 — or grave threat or violence to the person), II (the stranger), III (victim sixty or more; from 1.1.2004, Lei 10.741/2003 art. 118, F-g3-03).

units.title: Aumento de pena nos crimes contra instituições financeiras e prestadores de segurança privada
units.note: The increase of 1/3 up to double for crimes against financial institutions and private security providers, from 10.9.2024 (Lei 14.967/2024 art. 72, F-g3-03); listed among the causes of every offence of the Título that g3 encodes.

units.title: Violação de direito autoral
units.note: Every paragraph: caput (the violation, found under Lei nº 9.610/1998 as a delegated fact, fork F-g3b-01), § 1º (reproduction for profit), § 2º (dealing in pirated copies, and renting without authorisation), § 3º (on-demand offering), § 4º (the exceptions, which reach §§ 1º–3º and not the caput, F-g3b-03); each form's pena cominada, consummated and attempted (art. 14). Temporal scope: the wording of Lei nº 10.695/2003, in force 1.8.2003 (F-g3b-20); every rule refuses for an earlier fact. A computer program refuses by name: Lei nº 9.609/1998, art. 12 answers for it (F-g3b-02). Sweep entries M-sweep-b-37 (tested) and M-sweep-b-38 (no effect). Tests in cp-g3b-propriedade-imaterial-testes.l4.
