units.title: Atentado contra a liberdade de trabalho
units.note: Incisos I and II, each with its own pena cominada (violence's penalty in addition, shape 4); consummated and attempted (art. 14). "violência" read as against the person (fork F-g3b-06). For facts in neither inciso the pena refuses by name, since the article has no other preceito. Tests in cp-g3b-organizacao-do-trabalho-testes.l4.

units.title: Atentado contra a liberdade de contrato de trabalho e boicotagem violenta
units.note: Both figures (contract of employment; violent boycott, as not supplying and not acquiring); pena cominada with the violence's penalty in addition; consummated and attempted. Shares the case record of arts. 197–199. Fork F-g3b-06. Tests in cp-g3b-organizacao-do-trabalho-testes.l4.

units.title: Atentado contra a liberdade de associação
units.note: The one figure; pena cominada with the violence's penalty in addition; consummated and attempted. Fork F-g3b-06. Tests in cp-g3b-organizacao-do-trabalho-testes.l4.

units.title: Paralisação de trabalho, seguida de violência ou perturbação da ordem
units.note: Caput and parágrafo único ("pelo menos, três empregados", read as qualifying the abandonment only, F-g3b-07); violence against person or thing, by the participant (F-g3b-09); pena with the violence's penalty in addition; consummated and attempted. Tests in cp-g3b-organizacao-do-trabalho-testes.l4.

units.title: Paralisação de trabalho de interesse coletivo
units.note: Encoded as written, with art. 200's definition of "abandono coletivo" read in (F-g3b-08). Whether it reaches a lawful strike (CF art. 9º; Lei nº 7.783/1989) is fork F-g3b-10, left OPEN for a lawyer and for the sweep. Tests in cp-g3b-organizacao-do-trabalho-testes.l4.

units.title: Invasão de estabelecimento industrial, comercial ou agrícola. Sabotagem
units.note: Both figures (invasion or occupation; sabotage by damage or disposal), "com o intuito" as a finding; the establishment's kind; pena reclusão 1–3 e multa; consummated and attempted. Tests in cp-g3b-organizacao-do-trabalho-testes.l4.

units.title: Frustração de direito assegurado por lei trabalhista
units.note: Caput (the labour right, a finding under labour law, F-g3b-11), § 1º I and II ("coação" = violence or serious threat, F-g3b-12), § 2º's increase (any victim in the class, F-g3b-14; "deficiência física ou mental" excludes sensory, F-g3b-13). Temporal scope: penalty and causes from Lei nº 9.777/1998 (30.12.1998) and refused before; §§ 1º–2º not law before that day; the caput's 1940 definition answers for any date. Tests in cp-g3b-organizacao-do-trabalho-testes.l4.

units.title: Frustração de lei sobre a nacionalização do trabalho
units.note: The obligation relating to nationalisation of labour is a finding under the labour legislation (F-g3b-17); "fraude ou violência"; pena with the violence's penalty in addition; consummated and attempted. Tests in cp-g3b-organizacao-do-trabalho-testes.l4.

units.title: Exercício de atividade com infração de decisão administrativa
units.note: Read as a habitual crime (F-g3b-18): repeated practice while barred by an administrative decision; no attempt. Pena detenção 3 meses–2 anos ou multa. Tests in cp-g3b-organizacao-do-trabalho-testes.l4.

units.title: Aliciamento para o fim de emigração
units.note: Recruiting two or more workers (F-g3b-15) by fraud to take them abroad; consummated and attempted. Temporal scope: the wording of Lei nº 8.683/1993 (in force 16.7.1993), definition and penalty; everything refuses before. Tests in cp-g3b-organizacao-do-trabalho-testes.l4.

units.title: Aliciamento de trabalhadores de um local para outro do território nacional
units.note: Caput (enticing, kept apart from recruiting, F-g3b-23), § 1º (recruiting away from the place of work by fraud, charging, or not assuring the return, F-g3b-16), § 2º's increase; two or more workers (F-g3b-15). Temporal scope as art. 203 (Lei nº 9.777/1998). Tests in cp-g3b-organizacao-do-trabalho-testes.l4.

units.title: Ultraje a culto e impedimento ou perturbação de ato a ele relativo
units.note: All three figures (public mockery for a religious motive, of a particular person, F-g3b-22; preventing or disturbing worship; public vilification of an act or object of worship), consummated and attempted; parágrafo único as a one-third increase plus the violence's own penalty (violence against the person, F-g3b-06). Pena detenção 1 mês–1 ano ou multa. Tests in cp-g3b-sentimento-religioso-e-mortos-testes.l4.

units.title: Impedimento ou perturbação de cerimônia funerária
units.note: Preventing or disturbing a burial or funeral ceremony, per act; parágrafo único as in art. 208. Shares the acts record of arts. 209–212. Tests in cp-g3b-sentimento-religioso-e-mortos-testes.l4.

units.title: Violação de sepultura
units.note: Breaking into or desecrating a grave or funeral urn, per act; consummated and attempted. Pena reclusão 1–3 anos e multa. Tests in cp-g3b-sentimento-religioso-e-mortos-testes.l4.

units.title: Destruição, subtração ou ocultação de cadáver
units.note: Destroying, taking or hiding a corpse or part of it, per act; not the ashes (F-g3b-19); a stillborn child's body is a corpse (F-g3b-21). Pena reclusão 1–3 anos e multa. Tests in cp-g3b-sentimento-religioso-e-mortos-testes.l4.

units.title: Vilipêndio a cadáver
units.note: Vilifying a corpse or its ashes; not a part of it (F-g3b-19). Pena detenção 1–3 anos e multa. Tests in cp-g3b-sentimento-religioso-e-mortos-testes.l4.

units.title: Estupro
units.note: Caput (consummated and attempted, art. 14), § 1º (serious injury, gravíssima included — F-g4a-12; victim fourteen to seventeen, 'ou' read as 'e' — F-g4a-15) and § 2º (death), each pena cominada, the causes of arts. 226 and 234-A, and the limits with the attempt. Yields to art. 217-A by specialty (F-g4a-02). Definition and penalties from Lei nº 12.015/2009: refuses for a fact before 10.8.2009. Ação penal: art. 225. Tests in cp-g4a-liberdade-sexual-testes.l4.

units.title: (Incluído pela Lei nº 12.015, de 2009)
units.note: Revoked by Lei nº 12.015/2009; carried as a labelled stub (`art. 214 — revogado`). Its conduct is now art. 213's.

units.title: Violação sexual mediante fraude (Redação dada pela Lei nº 12.015, de 2009)
units.note: Caput (fraud or another means hampering free will; consummated and attempted), pena cominada, and the parágrafo único's fine for an economic aim (the caput's pena with the fine changed). Yields to arts. 217-A and 213 (F-g4a-02). Lei nº 12.015/2009: refuses before 10.8.2009.

units.title: Importunação sexual (Incluído pela Lei nº 13.718, de 2018)
units.note: The crime and its pena; 'se o ato não constitui crime mais grave' computed over arts. 213, 215 and 217-A plus a court finding for any other; an act with a person under fourteen is always art. 217-A (reserved fork F-sweep-c-07, M-sweep-c-12). Added by Lei nº 13.718/2018: not law before 25.9.2018.

units.title: Importunação sexual (Incluído pela Lei nº 13.718, de 2018)
units.note: Revoked by Lei nº 12.015/2009; labelled stub (`art. 216 — revogado`).

units.title: Assédio sexual (Incluído pela Lei nº 10.224, de 15 de 2001)
units.note: The crime (hierarchical superiority or ascendancy in employment, taken advantage of), its pena (detenção 1-2), and § 2º's increase of up to a third for a victim under eighteen (from 10.8.2009). Art. 226, II does not also count the authority that is the element (F-g4a-06). The vetoed parágrafo único is noted. Added by Lei nº 10.224/2001: not law before 16.5.2001.

units.title: Registro não autorizado da intimidade sexual
units.note: Caput and parágrafo único (the montage), consummated or attempted, and the pena (detenção 6 months to 1 year, e multa). 'sem autorização dos participantes' read as every participant (F-g4a-16). Capítulo I-A, not named in art. 225 (F-g4a-04). Added by Lei nº 13.772/2018: not law before 20.12.2018.

units.title: Sedução
units.note: Revoked by Lei nº 11.106/2005; labelled stub (`art. 217 — revogado`).

units.title: Estupro de vulnerável (Incluído pela Lei nº 12.015, de 2009)
units.note: Caput and § 1º (consummated and attempted), §§ 3º and 4º (results), the three penas in the wording of Lei nº 15.280/2025 (refusing before 8.12.2025), the causes of arts. 226 and 234-A (disability as the element — F-g4a-07), the limits; §§ 4º-A and 5º encoded by not reading consent, experience, earlier relations or pregnancy, tested as invariance on both sides of 8.3.2026 (reserved fork F-sweep-c-06, M-sweep-c-10, M-sweep-c-11); § 2º vetoed. Definition from Lei nº 12.015/2009: refuses before 10.8.2009.

units.title: Corrupção de menores
units.note: The crime (consummated when the victim does the act — F-g4a-10; contact with the third person is art. 217-A — F-g4a-09) and its pena (Lei nº 15.280/2025, refusing before 8.12.2025); causes of arts. 226 and 234-A. Definition from Lei nº 12.015/2009: refuses before 10.8.2009. Parágrafo único vetoed.

units.title: Parágrafo único. (VETADO). (Incluído pela Lei nº 12.015, de 2009)
units.note: The crime (practising in the presence of, or inducing to watch, a person under fourteen, for lust; consummated or attempted) and its pena (Lei nº 15.280/2025, refusing before 8.12.2025); causes. Added by Lei nº 12.015/2009: not law before 10.8.2009.

units.title: (Redação dada pela Lei nº 15.280, de 2025)
units.note: Caput and § 2º, I and II (the agent's part), consummated when the victim is in exploitation (F-g4a-11; 'exploração sexual' a finding, F-g4a-13), the pena (Lei nº 15.280/2025, refusing before 8.12.2025; § 1º revoked by it), § 3º (licence revoked on a § 2º, II conviction), causes with the disability as the element (F-g4a-07). Added by Lei nº 12.015/2009: not law before 10.8.2009.

units.title: § 2o Incorre nas mesmas penas: (Incluído pela Lei nº 12.015, de 2009)
units.note: Caput (the eight verbs, the three contents, consent for sex scenes), the § 2º exclusion (F-g4a-14), 'se o fato não constitui crime mais grave' as a finding, the pena (Lei nº 15.280/2025, refusing before 8.12.2025), and § 1º's increase plus arts. 226 and 234-A. Added by Lei nº 13.718/2018: not law before 25.9.2018.

units.title: Rapto violento ou mediante fraude
units.note: Revoked by Lei nº 11.106/2005 (Capítulo III — Do rapto); carried in the labelled stub `arts. 219 a 222 — revogados`.

units.title: Rapto consensual
units.note: Revoked by Lei nº 11.106/2005 (Capítulo III — Do rapto); carried in the labelled stub `arts. 219 a 222 — revogados`.

units.title: Diminuição de pena
units.note: Revoked by Lei nº 11.106/2005 (Capítulo III — Do rapto); carried in the labelled stub `arts. 219 a 222 — revogados`.

units.title: Concurso de rapto e outro crime
units.note: Revoked by Lei nº 11.106/2005 (Capítulo III — Do rapto); carried in the labelled stub `arts. 219 a 222 — revogados`.

units.title: DISPOSIÇÕES GERAIS
units.note: Revoked by Lei nº 12.015/2009; carried in the labelled stub `arts. 223 e 224 — revogados`.

units.title: DISPOSIÇÕES GERAIS
units.note: Revoked by Lei nº 12.015/2009; carried in the labelled stub `arts. 223 e 224 — revogados`.

units.title: Ação penal
units.note: `a ação penal do art. 225`: pública incondicionada for the crimes of Capítulos I and II from 25.9.2018 (Lei nº 13.718/2018); NOTHING outside those chapters (art. 100 decides; Capítulo I-A — F-g4a-04); a named refusal before 25.9.2018, the 2009 wording not being in the source (reserved fork F-sweep-c-09, M-sweep-c-14: STJ Súmula 670, STF Súmula 608). Parágrafo único revoked.

units.title: Aumento de pena
units.note: Incisos I (a quarter), II (half; the list of relations; not the authority that is art. 216-A's element — F-g4a-06) and IV (a third to two thirds; estupro coletivo and corretivo), with the reach read as Capítulos I, I-A and II and IV as estupro's, displacing I (F-g4a-03); III revoked. STJ Tema 1215 on art. 61, II, f (reserved fork F-sweep-c-08, M-sweep-c-13). The list of causes refuses for a fact before 25.9.2018 (the earlier wording of II and IV).

units.title: Mediação para servir a lascívia de outrem
units.note: Caput, § 1º (fourteen to seventeen; the relations; the person entrusted for education, treatment or custody), § 2º (violence, threat or fraud, besides the violence's penalty), § 3º (fine for profit); consummated or attempted (F-g4a-10); a victim under fourteen is art. 218's (F-g4a-02). The penalty refuses before 29.3.2005 (Lei nº 11.106/2005 re-worded § 1º).

units.title: § 3º - Se o crime é cometido com o fim de lucro, aplica-se também multa.
units.note: Caput (not 'submeter'; a victim under eighteen or without discernment is art. 218-B's — F-g4a-02), §§ 1º-3º with each preceito's own fine, consummated or attempted (F-g4a-11). Lei nº 12.015/2009: refuses before 10.8.2009.

units.title: Casa de prostituição
units.note: The crime ('exploração sexual' a finding — F-g4a-13; profit and direct mediation read by no rule, tested as invariance) and its 1940 pena. Habitual: no attempt (F-g4a-11). Definition from Lei nº 12.015/2009: refuses before 10.8.2009.

units.title: Rufianismo
units.note: Caput (1940, any date), §§ 1º and 2º (Lei nº 12.015/2009: the penalty refuses before 10.8.2009); a victim under fourteen is not in § 1º's words (F-g4a-17). Habitual: no attempt.

units.title: Pena - reclusão, de 3 (três) a 6 (seis) anos, e multa. (Redação dada pela Lei nº 12.015, de 2009)
units.note: Revoked by Lei nº 13.344/2016; carried in the labelled stub `arts. 231, 231-A e 232 — revogados`.

units.title: (Revogado pela Lei nº 13.344, de 2016) (Vigência)
units.note: Revoked by Lei nº 13.344/2016; carried in the labelled stub `arts. 231, 231-A e 232 — revogados`.

units.title: (Revogado pela Lei nº 13.344, de 2016) (Vigência)
units.note: Revoked by Lei nº 12.015/2009; carried in the labelled stub `arts. 231, 231-A e 232 — revogados`.

units.title: Promoção de migração ilegal
units.note: Caput and § 1º (consummated by the acts of promotion — F-g4a-18), the pena, § 2º's increase, § 3º, and art. 234-A (F-g4a-05). Added by Lei nº 13.445/2017: not law before 21.11.2017.

units.title: Ato obsceno
units.note: The crime ('obsceno' a finding — F-g4a-19; the three kinds of place) and its pena (detenção 3 months to 1 year, ou multa).

units.title: Escrito ou objeto obsceno
units.note: Caput (verbs, aims, the object found obscene) and parágrafo único I-III, and the pena (detenção 6 months to 2 years, ou multa).

units.title: Aumento de pena (Incluído pela Lei nº 12.015, de 2009)
units.note: Incisos III (pregnancy: half to two thirds) and IV (a sexually transmitted disease the agent knew or should have known of; an older or disabled victim, not where the disability is the element — F-g4a-07), for every crime of Título VI, art. 232-A included (F-g4a-05); I and II vetoed. The list refuses before 25.9.2018 (Lei nº 13.718/2018 re-worded III and IV).

units.title: II  (VETADO); (Incluído pela Lei nº 12.015, de 2009)
units.note: Caput (segredo de justiça), § 1º (public name, CPF and offence after a first-instance conviction for the listed articles, unless the judge orders secrecy), § 2º (acquittal on appeal) and § 3º (electronic monitoring), with the temporal reach of Lei nº 15.035/2024 read in F-g4a-08.

units.title: (Incluído pela Lei nº 15.035, de 2024)
units.note: Vetoed; labelled stub (`art. 234-C — vetado`).

units.title: Bigamia
units.note: Caput and § 1º (consummated or attempted), § 2º (annulment: no crime), the two penas (§ 1º's species left to the judge).

units.title: Induzimento a erro essencial e ocultação de impedimento
units.note: The crime (no attempt — F-g4a-20), its pena, the ação penal privada and the condition that the annulment be final (parágrafo único).

units.title: Conhecimento prévio de impedimento
units.note: The crime (an impediment causing absolute nullity, known; yields to art. 235 — F-g4a-02), consummated or attempted, and its pena.

units.title: Simulação de autoridade para celebração de casamento
units.note: The crime, 'se o fato não constitui crime mais grave' as a finding, and its pena.

units.title: Simulação de casamento
units.note: The crime, 'se o fato não constitui elemento de crime mais grave' as a finding, and its pena.

units.title: Adultério
units.note: Revoked by Lei nº 11.106/2005; labelled stub (`art. 240 — revogado`).

units.title: Registro de nascimento inexistente
units.note: The crime, consummated or attempted, and its pena.

units.title: Parto suposto. Supressão ou alteração de direito inerente ao estado civil de recém-nascido
units.note: The three limbs ('suprimindo ou alterando' qualifies the last — F-g4a-21), consummated or attempted, the two penas and the parágrafo único's judicial pardon returned as options. Lei nº 6.898/1981: refuses before 1.4.1981.

units.title: Sonegação de estado de filiação
units.note: The crime, consummated or attempted, and its pena (reclusão 1-5, e multa).

units.title: Abandono material
units.note: Caput (both parts; 'cônjuge' not the companion — F-g4a-22) from 1.1.2004 (Lei nº 10.741/2003), parágrafo único from 13.9.1968 (Lei nº 5.478/1968, F-g4a-01); the pena with plain multa, the minimum-wage multiple cancelled by Lei nº 7.209/1984 art. 2º and quoted inert (sweep entry M-sweep-c-27, binding).

units.title: Entrega de filho menor a pessoa inidônea
units.note: Caput (consummated or attempted), §§ 1º and 2º and their penas. Lei nº 7.251/1984: refuses before 21.11.1984. Whether ECA arts. 238-239 displaced § 2º is an open question (notes/g4a.md).

units.title: Abandono intelectual
units.note: The crime ('idade escolar' a finding) and its pena (detenção 15 days to 1 month, ou multa).

units.title: Pena - detenção, de quinze dias a um mês, ou multa.
units.note: The crime (incisos I-IV as a list of what the agent allowed) and its pena.

units.title: Induzimento a fuga, entrega arbitrária ou sonegação de incapazes
units.note: The three conducts (minor or person under interdiction) and the pena. The Senado record's 'Encerramento de Vigência' of a non-existent parágrafo único (S-sweep-c-03) is noted.

units.title: Subtração de incapazes
units.note: The crime (consummated or attempted; § 1º read a contrario — F-g4a-23; 'se o fato não constitui elemento de outro crime' a finding), its pena, and § 2º's judicial pardon returned as options.

units.title: Incêndio
units.note: Caput (the crime, consummated or attempted, art. 14), § 1º I and II (increase of one third, intentional form only, fork F-g4b-04; reaches the fine, F-g4b-03), § 2º (culpable form and its pena). Art. 258 applies to it (forms, causes and the culpable-death preceito through `a forma qualificada do art. 258 que incide`). Common danger read as an element (F-g4b-01). The 1940 text: answers for any date. Tests in cp-g4b-perigo-comum-testes.l4.

units.title: Explosão
units.note: Caput and § 1º (the substance chooses the pena: dynamite or analogous, or another; the modes read with the substance, F-g4b-05), § 2º (increase of one third, reading art. 250 § 1º, I and II), § 3º (culpable explosion, a preceito depending on the substance). Art. 258 applies to it (forms, causes and the culpable-death preceito through `a forma qualificada do art. 258 que incide`). Tests in cp-g4b-perigo-comum-testes.l4.

units.title: Uso de gás tóxico ou asfixiante
units.note: Caput (consummated or attempted) and parágrafo único (culpable form). Art. 258 applies to it (forms, causes and the culpable-death preceito through `a forma qualificada do art. 258 que incide`). Tests in cp-g4b-perigo-comum-testes.l4.

units.title: Fabrico, fornecimento, aquisição posse ou transporte de explosivos ou gás tóxico, ou asfixiante
units.note: The five verbs, the three objects and 'sem licença da autoridade'; intentional only (art. 18, parágrafo único). No danger element: the Code presumes it. Art. 258 applies to it (forms, causes and the culpable-death preceito through `a forma qualificada do art. 258 que incide`). 'substância ou engenho explosivo' is two members. From 23.12.2003 Lei nº 10.826/2003, art. 16, § 1º, III takes possessing or making an explosive device (M-sweep-c-32, fork F-sweep-c-18, derogacaoParcial): such a fact refuses by name, as that law is not encoded; the rest of art. 253 stands. Tests in cp-g4b-perigo-comum-testes.l4.

units.title: Inundação
units.note: The crime, intentional (consummated or attempted) or culpable; the preceito depends on the fact ('no caso de dolo ... no caso de culpa', PLAN § 2.2.1 shape 7). Art. 258 applies to it (forms, causes and the culpable-death preceito through `a forma qualificada do art. 258 que incide`). Tests in cp-g4b-perigo-comum-testes.l4.

units.title: Perigo de inundação
units.note: Remover, destruir ou inutilizar an obstacle or work against flooding, exposing others to common danger; intentional only. 'em prédio próprio ou alheio' carried inert. Art. 258 applies to it (forms, causes and the culpable-death preceito through `a forma qualificada do art. 258 que incide`). Tests in cp-g4b-perigo-comum-testes.l4.

units.title: Desabamento ou desmoronamento
units.note: Caput (consummated or attempted) and parágrafo único (culpable form). Art. 258 applies to it (forms, causes and the culpable-death preceito through `a forma qualificada do art. 258 que incide`). Tests in cp-g4b-perigo-comum-testes.l4.

units.title: Subtração, ocultação ou inutilização de material de salvamento
units.note: Both modes (taking, hiding or disabling rescue equipment; preventing or hindering the service), 'por ocasião de ... desastre ou calamidade' read with both; intentional only. Art. 258 applies to it (forms, causes and the culpable-death preceito through `a forma qualificada do art. 258 que incide`). Tests in cp-g4b-perigo-comum-testes.l4.

units.title: Formas qualificadas de crime de perigo comum
units.note: The four arms: intentional crime with serious injury (+1/2) or death (x2); culpable crime with any injury (+1/2) or death (art. 121 § 3º's pena, borrowed and named for its source, +1/3). Art. 19 and the preterintentional reading (F-g4b-02) through `imputação do resultado`; 'de natureza grave' includes gravíssima (F-g4b-06); a death with an injury takes the death's arm (F-g4b-07). Applied to Capítulo I directly, to arts. 260-262 by art. 263, to Capítulo III by art. 285. Tests in cp-g4b-perigo-comum-testes.l4.

units.title: Difusão de doença ou praga
units.note: Caput (consummated or attempted) and parágrafo único (culpable form, 'ou multa'). Art. 258 applies to it (forms, causes and the culpable-death preceito through `a forma qualificada do art. 258 que incide`). The caput's intentional form is tacitly revoked by Lei nº 9.605/1998, art. 61, milder and so retroactive (M-sweep-c-31, fork F-sweep-c-17, revogadoSalvoCulposa): its words stay encoded, the crime and penalty refuse by name; the culpable form stands. Tests in cp-g4b-perigo-comum-testes.l4.

units.title: Perigo de desastre ferroviário
units.note: Caput with incisos I to IV (consummated or attempted), § 1º (disaster: its own pena), § 2º (culpable, only with a disaster), § 3º (what 'estrada de ferro' means). No danger element beyond inciso IV's words (F-g4b-08). Art. 258 through art. 263 when a disaster occurred. Tests in cp-g4b-transportes-e-servicos-testes.l4.

units.title: Atentado contra a segurança de transporte marítimo, fluvial ou aéreo
units.note: Caput (both modes), § 1º (wreck: its own pena), § 2º (the fine added, intentional forms only), § 3º (culpable, only with a wreck). Art. 258 through art. 263 when the wreck occurred. Tests in cp-g4b-transportes-e-servicos-testes.l4.

units.title: Atentado contra a segurança de outro meio de transporte
units.note: Caput, § 1º (disaster: reclusão), § 2º (culpable, only with a disaster). Art. 258 through art. 263 when a disaster occurred. Tests in cp-g4b-transportes-e-servicos-testes.l4.

units.title: Forma qualificada
units.note: `a forma do art. 258 que o art. 263 faz incidir`: art. 258 for arts. 260-262 only 'no caso de desastre ou sinistro'. Tests in cp-g4b-transportes-e-servicos-testes.l4.

units.title: Arremesso de projétil
units.note: Caput (consummated or attempted; intentional only) and parágrafo único (injury of any grade: its own pena; death: art. 121 § 3º's pena plus one third, the borrowed preceito of cp-g4b-perigo-comum.l4). Art. 19 and F-g4b-02 as for art. 258. Tests in cp-g4b-transportes-e-servicos-testes.l4.

units.title: Atentado contra a segurança de serviço de utilidade pública
units.note: Caput and parágrafo único (increase of one third to one half), the paragraph in force from 7.12.1967 (Lei nº 5.346/1967, art. 4º: 30 days after DOU 7.11.1967); before it the cause does not exist. Tests in cp-g4b-transportes-e-servicos-testes.l4.

units.title: Vigência
units.note: Caput (1940 words: any date) and § 1º (in force 2.4.2013, Lei nº 12.737/2012; 'interrompe', not 'perturba'), the pena and § 2º I-II (doubling, reaching the fine, F-g4b-03) in Lei nº 15.397/2026's wording: penalty rules refuse for facts before 4.5.2026, and the causes refuse by a refusal of their own for 29.7.2025 to 3.5.2026, when Lei nº 15.181/2025's § 2º (not in the source; S-sweep-c-04) governed. Tests in cp-g4b-transportes-e-servicos-testes.l4.

units.title: Epidemia
units.note: Caput (consummated or attempted; definition 1940, any date; pena Lei nº 8.072/1990's, refusing before 26.7.1990), § 1º (death doubles, art. 19 and F-g4b-02), § 2º (culpable, a preceito depending on whether death resulted; 1940, any date). Excepted from art. 258 by art. 285, and asserted so. Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-epidemia-e-agua-testes.l4.

units.title: Infração de medida sanitária preventiva
units.note: Caput and parágrafo único (+1/3 for a public-health official or a physician, pharmacist, dentist or nurse; not a veterinarian). 'determinação do poder público' is any federated entity's act within its sphere: STF Tema 1246, M-sweep-c-08, fork F-sweep-c-04, read through the issuing entity. Art. 258 through art. 285 (`a forma do art. 258 que o art. 285 faz incidir`). Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-epidemia-e-agua-testes.l4.

units.title: Omissão de notificação de doença
units.note: The physician's failure to report a disease of compulsory notification; an omission, so no attempt (F-g4b-11); intentional only. Art. 258 through art. 285 (`a forma do art. 258 que o art. 285 faz incidir`). Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-epidemia-e-agua-testes.l4.

units.title: Envenenamento de água potável ou de substância alimentícia ou medicinal
units.note: Caput and § 1º (dealing in the poisoned water or substance, 'a mesma pena'), § 2º (culpable). Definition 1940, any date; the caput's pena (and § 1º's) Lei nº 8.072/1990's, refusing before 26.7.1990. Art. 258 through art. 285 (`a forma do art. 258 que o art. 285 faz incidir`). Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-epidemia-e-agua-testes.l4.

units.title: Corrupção ou poluição de água potável
units.note: Caput (consummated or attempted) and parágrafo único (culpable). Art. 258 through art. 285 (`a forma do art. 258 que o art. 285 faz incidir`). Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-epidemia-e-agua-testes.l4.

units.title: Pena - detenção, de dois meses a um ano.
units.note: Caput, § 1º-A (dealing in the caput's product, F-g4b-14), § 1º (drinks), § 2º (culpable). All Lei nº 9.677/1998 (in force 3.7.1998) wording: the crime and the pena refuse for an earlier fact. Art. 258 through art. 285 (`a forma do art. 258 que o art. 285 faz incidir`). Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-alimentos-e-medicamentos-testes.l4.

units.note: Caput and § 5º (the crime; 'exercer' read as habitual, F-g4b-10; no attempt, F-g4b-11), § 1º (fine for profit), §§ 2º-4º (the other crimes the agent also answers for, as a list). units.title: Charlatanismo
units.note: The crime (consummated or attempted) and pena. Art. 258 through art. 285 (`a forma do art. 258 que o art. 285 faz incidir`). Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-exercicio-ilegal-testes.l4.

units.title: Curandeirismo
units.note: Caput with incisos I-III ('habitualmente' read into all three through 'Exercer', F-g4b-10; no attempt) and parágrafo único (fine when paid). Art. 258 through art. 285 (`a forma do art. 258 que o art. 285 faz incidir`). Tests in cp-g4b-saude-publica-exercicio-ilegal-testes.l4.

units.note: `a forma do art. 258 que o art. 285 faz incidir`: art. 258 for every crime of Capítulo III, NOTHING for art. 267 ('salvo quanto ao definido no art. 267') and for art. 282 (fork F-g4b-09). units.title: Incitação ao crime
units.note: Caput ('crime', not contravenção; a crime the incitement points to, F-g4b-17; consummated or attempted) and parágrafo único (in force 1.12.2021, Lei nº 14.197/2021: before it, not a crime). 'ou multa', an alternative. Tests in cp-g4b-paz-publica-testes.l4.

units.title: Apologia de crime ou criminoso
units.note: The crime (a criminal fact that happened, or its author, F-g4b-18), read down by ADPF 187 (M-sweep-c-04, binding): the advocacy of drug legalisation, public demonstrations included, is excluded (`excluída pela interpretação conforme (ADPF 187)`), for every fact. Tests in cp-g4b-paz-publica-testes.l4.

units.title: Associação Criminosa
units.note: Caput (a stable bond, F-g4b-19; three or more associates counted as persons, punishable or not, F-g4b-21), § 1º (up to half: armed, F-g4b-20, or a child or adolescent on the date of the fact), § 2º (soliciting or hiring a crime from a member; in force 30.10.2025; the solicited crime's penalty applies too). Lei nº 12.850/2013's wording, in force 19.9.2013: before it the article refuses; § 1º is 12.850's parágrafo único renumbered by Lei nº 15.245/2025 (F-g4b-24). Lei nº 8.072/1990, art. 8º (M-sweep-c-30, binding): reclusão 3-6 for an association aimed at heinous crimes or torture, and its parágrafo único's decrease of one to two thirds for the associate who denounces the group; for trafficking and terrorism the association falls under special laws not encoded (Lei nº 11.343/2006, art. 35; Lei nº 13.260/2016), and the penalty refuses by name (F-g4b-23), as it does for § 2º with such a crime solicited. Tests in cp-g4b-paz-publica-testes.l4.

units.title: (Incluído dada pela Lei nº 12.720, de 2012)
units.note: The five verbs, the four bands, the purpose; in force 28.9.2012 (Lei nº 12.720/2012): before it, not a crime. The minimum membership the article does not state is the fact supplier's finding (F-g4b-22); no attempt (F-g4b-11). Tests in cp-g4b-paz-publica-testes.l4.

units.title: Peculato
units.note: Caput and § 1º (intentional: consummated and attempted), § 2º (culpable), § 3º (effect of repairing the damage, with the same-day case refused, F-g6a-08), penas of caput, § 1º (the caput's) and § 2º. The agent is a funcionário público under art. 327 on the day of the act (`cp-g6a-comum.l4`); art. 327 § 2º's increase applies. Forks F-g6a-06, -07, -08. As enacted in 1940; answers for any date. Tests in cp-g6a-peculato-a-concussao-testes.l4.

units.title: Peculato mediante erro de outrem
units.note: Crime (consummated and attempted), pena, causes. The agent is a funcionário público under art. 327 on the day of the act (`cp-g6a-comum.l4`); art. 327 § 2º's increase applies. The agent is read under Capítulo I's heading (F-g6a-04). As enacted in 1940. Tests in cp-g6a-peculato-a-concussao-testes.l4.

units.title: Inserção de dados falsos em sistema de informações (Incluído pela Lei nº 9.983, de 2000)
units.note: Crime (consummated and attempted), pena, causes. The agent is a funcionário público under art. 327 on the day of the act (`cp-g6a-comum.l4`); art. 327 § 2º's increase applies. Added by Lei nº 9.983/2000: not a crime before 15.10.2000, refused on 15.10.2000, in force from 16.10.2000 (S-sweep-c-15; F-g6a-22). Tests in cp-g6a-peculato-a-concussao-testes.l4.

units.title: Modificação ou alteração não autorizada de sistema de informações (Incluído pela Lei nº 9.983, de 2000)
units.note: Crime (consummated and attempted), pena, the parágrafo único's increase (1/3 to 1/2; whether it reaches the fine is F-g6a-09), causes. Tests in cp-g6a-peculato-a-concussao-testes.l4. [g6a corrected this unit's title: the enumeration had taken the line before the article, 'Pena – reclusão, de 2 (dois) a 12 (doze) anos, e multa. units.title: Extravio, sonegação ou inutilização de livro ou documento
units.note: Crime (consummated and attempted), pena (no fine), causes; 'se o fato não constitui crime mais grave' as the judge's finding (F-g6a-10). units.title: Emprego irregular de verbas ou rendas públicas
units.note: Crime (consummated and attempted), pena ('ou multa'), causes. The agent is a funcionário público under art. 327 on the day of the act (`cp-g6a-comum.l4`); art. 327 § 2º's increase applies. F-g6a-04. Tests in cp-g6a-peculato-a-concussao-testes.l4.

Tests in cp-g6a-peculato-a-concussao-testes.l4.

Caput's pena re-written by Lei nº 10.763/2003 (in force 13.11.2003): refused for an earlier fact. Tests in cp-g6a-corrupcao-passiva-a-sigilo-testes.l4.

units.title: Facilitação de contrabando ou descaminho
units.note: Crime (consummated and attempted), pena, causes; '(art. 334)' read as reaching art. 334-A's contrabando (F-g6a-12). Tests in cp-g6a-corrupcao-passiva-a-sigilo-testes.l4.

units.title: Exercício funcional ilegalmente antecipado ou prolongado

Tests in cp-g6a-descaminho-a-sonegacao-testes.l4.

units.note: Both conducts, crime (consummated and attempted), pena ('ou multa'). Tests in cp-g6a-descaminho-a-sonegacao-testes.l4.

units.note: Caput I-III, crime (requiring the definitive constitution of the credit: M-sweep-c-23 / F-sweep-c-15), pena; § 1º extinction (declaration before the ação fiscal; same-day refused, F-g6a-08); §§ 5º-6º (LC nº 225/2026, in force 9.1.2026; acts from then on, F-g6a-19); Lei nº 10.684/2003 art. 9º (M-sweep-c-28, binding: parcelamento suspension, extinction by full payment, the persistent-debtor exclusion; F-g6a-20); § 2º's and § 3º's options for the judge, the administrative minimum and § 4º's readjusted ceiling as parameters (the readjusted value refused by name if asked of the encoding, F-g6a-21).
